card.title: Mean speed theorem
card.body: A body whose velocity changes at a steady rate covers the same distance as a body moving the whole time at the speed it had at the **middle** of the interval.
card.from: the Merton scholars in Oxford (c. 1335). Oresme gave a picture proof with areas (c. 1350); Galileo used it for falling bodies (1638).
card.example: From 0 to 20 m/s steadily in 10 s → same distance as 10 m/s for 10 s = 100 m.
card.analogy: A ramp of speed has the same area under it as a flat line at its middle height.
